name: com.alibaba.wireless.security.open.middletier.fc.ui.ContainerActivity
description: Alibaba SecurityGuard's middle-tier verification opens this web page for a session-specific security challenge and sends the result back to the SDK. It can also handle security-package download or update links.
disableEffect: Security checks or update actions that rely on this page may not complete, blocking an app feature that depends on them.
